title: English Conversation 37:  An Accusation
content: 1. to steal something: to take something that belongs to another person without permission - Somebody stole my phone. - He was fired because he stole money from the company. 2. a liar: a person who lies (usually often) - Don't trust him. He is a liar. - She is a liar. Don't believe what she says. 3. proof: evidence - Do you have proof that he stole your phone? - We have no proof that aliens are real.
